# U71: See your check-ins before you start: the week’s list, Start with the first or pick any, a kept draft said on its row, the table one line away; someone who owns no goal is told so

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `CHECK-IN-QUEUE`
- **Budget:** at most 10 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U71

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Step.** Open “Check-in” from the menu (the sidebar on a computer; the tab bar, or its More, on a phone).
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** The “To do this week” section shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the {worked out in the journey as `n === 1 ? 'Check in on ${first}' : 'Start with ${first}'`} link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `n >= 2 && /^Week \d+, .+\. Check-ins are due by \w+/.test((await p.locator('.ciq-when').innerText()).trim()) && (await rows.locator('.ciq-status').allInnerTexts()).every((t) => t.trim().length > 0) && (await rows.locator('.ciq-said').allInnerTexts()).every((t) => /^(Last week|Week \d+): |^No check-in yet$/.test(t.trim()))`, where `const todo = p.getByRole('region', { name: 'To do this week' })`; `const rows = todo.locator('.ciq-row')`; `const n = await rows.count()`. Else it says: the list has {n} rows, or a row doesn’t say its status and what it last said.
- _Note:_ The sidebar stays (not focus mode); Check-in is lit.
- **Check:** (`parity`) on a phone or there are 1 of the side (`.side [aria-current="page"]`) (else: Check-in is not lit on its list).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “queue”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Start with opens the first listed goal, and the walk counts what the list counts (build review of #114).
- **Step.** Press the {worked out in the journey as `n === 1 ? 'Check in on ${first}' : 'Start with ${first}'`} link.
- **Check:** A week in the check-in shows.
- **Step.** Press the “Close and keep the draft” button.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** The “To do this week” section shows.
- _Note:_ Any row opens its own goal; closing keeps the draft, back on the list, which says so on that row.
- **Step.** Press the “Check in:” link in a goal’s row in the check-in’s list (`.ciq-row`) in the “To do this week” section.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/check-in/…”.
- **Step.** Type “1” into the “This week’s value” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Close and keep the draft” button.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** A goal’s row in the check-in’s list (`.ciq-row`) shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/Draft kept/.test(await row.innerText().catch(() => '')) && await row.getByRole('link', { name: /^Carry on: / }).isVisible().catch(() => false)`, where `const todo = p.getByRole('region', { name: 'To do this week' })`; `const rows = todo.locator('.ciq-row')`; `const n = await rows.count()`; `const pick = rows.nth(n - 1)`; `const title = (await pick.locator('.ciq-title').innerText()).trim()`; `const row = p.locator('.ciq-row', { hasText: title })`. Else it says: closing did not come back to the list with “Draft kept” on {title}.
- _Note:_ The table is one line away, and it is Check-in's too.
- **Step.** Press the “Or type all your numbers in one table” link.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/quick-check-in”.
- **Check:** The h1 in the main, or the h1 in the focus, or the h1 (`main h1, .focus h1, h1`) shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `/Check-in/.test(await p.title())`. Else it says: the table's page is called “{p.title()}”.
- _Note:_ Home's Start check-in still goes straight into the first form, the walk through every due goal.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Start check-in / Pick up where you left off” link in Home’s lead.
- **Check:** The address becomes “check-in?start=1”.
- **Check:** A week in the check-in shows.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `walkOk && /of \d+$/.test((await p.locator('.ci-week').innerText().catch(() => '')).trim())`, where `const todo = p.getByRole('region', { name: 'To do this week' })`; `const rows = todo.locator('.ciq-row')`; `const n = await rows.count()`; `const first = (await rows.first().locator('.ciq-title').innerText()).trim()`; `const walkSays = (await p.locator('.ci-week').innerText()).trim()`; `const opens = (await p.locator('.focus h1').first().innerText()).trim()`; `` const walkOk = (n === 1 || walkSays.endsWith(`1 of ${n}`)) && opens.includes(first) ``. Else it says: {a value worked out in the journey}.
- _Note:_ Someone who owns no goal, at the address typed by hand, is told so. (The demo's controls are on Home, not in a form.)
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- Switch to Oskar in the Demo panel (the quiet Demo button): a role card’s person, or anyone else by typing their name.
- Go to `/check-in` in the demo.
- **Check:** “You don’t own a goal in” is shown (else: Check-in does not say Oskar owns no goal).
- **Check:** (`errors`) the “See the goals you watch” link is visible and the “Set up a goal” link is visible (else: no way on for someone who owns no goal).
- Close this browser.
